import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem closed_subspace_countable_separating_trace_basis {K : Type*} [MetricSpace K] [CompactSpace K] {A : Set K} (hA : IsClosed A) :
  ∃ (B : Set (Set K)), Set.Countable B ∧
    (∀ U ∈ B, IsOpen U) ∧
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
      (Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B) ∧
    (∀ x y : A, x ≠ y → ∃ U ∈ B,
      x ∈ (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U ∧
      y ∉ (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) := by
  set B := TopologicalSpace.countableBasis K
  have hB_count : B.Countable := TopologicalSpace.countable_countableBasis K
  have hB_basis : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B := TopologicalSpace.isBasis_countableBasis K
  refine ⟨B, hB_count, fun U hU => hB_basis.isOpen hU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply TopologicalSpace.isTopologicalBasis_of_isOpen_of_nhds
    · rintro _ ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
      exact (hB_basis.isOpen hU).preimage continuous_subtype_val
    · intro a u ha hu
      rw [isOpen_induced_iff] at hu
      obtain ⟨W, hW_open, rfl⟩ := hu
      have haW : (a : K) ∈ W := ha
      obtain ⟨U, hU_B, haU, hUW⟩ := hB_basis.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hW_open.mem_nhds haW)
      refine ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' U, Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hU_B, haU, Set.preimage_mono hUW⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    have h_ne : (x : K) ≠ (y : K) := fun h => hxy (Subtype.ext h)
    have h_nhds : {(y : K)}ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (x : K) :=
      isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds h_ne
    obtain ⟨U, hU_B, hxU, hUy⟩ := hB_basis.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
    exact ⟨U, hU_B, hxU, fun hyU => hUy hyU rfl⟩
